From: ruban000 <rubanzenphonem2pro@gmail.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:25:49 +0530
Subject: [PATCH 02/94] ci(android): add APK build workflow

---
 .github/workflows/android-apk.yml | 88 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 88 insertions(+)
 create mode 100644 .github/workflows/android-apk.yml

diff --git a/.github/workflows/android-apk.yml b/.github/workflows/android-apk.yml
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..e1a1789b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/android-apk.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,88 @@
+name: Android APK
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+  pull_request:
+    paths:
+      - "android/**"
+      - "dm/**"
+      - "scripts/**"
+      - ".github/workflows/android-apk.yml"
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - android
+      - "feature/**"
+    paths:
+      - "android/**"
+      - "dm/**"
+      - "scripts/**"
+      - ".github/workflows/android-apk.yml"
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: android-apk-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+jobs:
+  build:
+    name: Build arm64 Android APK
+    runs-on: macos-15
+    timeout-minutes: 180
+    steps:
+      - name: Check out source
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          submodules: recursive
+
+      - name: Set up Java 17
+        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
+        with:
+          distribution: temurin
+          java-version: "17"
+
+      - name: Set up Android SDK and NDK
+        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
+
+      - name: Install pinned Android NDK
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          sdkmanager "ndk;28.2.13676358" "cmake;3.22.1"
+          echo "ANDROID_NDK_HOME=$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/ndk/28.2.13676358" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+
+      - name: Set up .NET 10
+        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
+        with:
+          dotnet-version: "10.0.x"
+
+      - name: Set up Python 3.14
+        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
+        with:
+          python-version: "3.14"
+
+      - name: Install native build tools
+        run: brew install ninja
+
+      - name: Build the on-device packer stage
+        shell: zsh {0}
+        run: |
+          zsh android/ondevice/build.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/nxnative-pack"
+
+      - name: Configure Android SDK path
+        run: |
+          printf 'sdk.dir=%s\n' "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT" > android/app/local.properties
+
+      - name: Build APK
+        working-directory: android/app
+        run: |
+          chmod +x gradlew
+          ./gradlew --no-daemon -PnxPackStage="$RUNNER_TEMP/nxnative-pack/stage" apk
+
+      - name: Upload APK
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: Banana-Native-Android-arm64
+          path: android/app/out/*.apk
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 14

+    /** Layered PS5-inspired ambient background: drifting light fields, depth ribbons and slow particles. */
+    private static final class Ps5AmbientBackground extends android.graphics.drawable.Drawable
+            implements android.graphics.drawable.Animatable {
+        private final android.graphics.Paint paint = new android.graphics.Paint(android.graphics.Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
+        private final android.graphics.Path ribbon = new android.graphics.Path();
+        private final android.animation.ValueAnimator animator = android.animation.ValueAnimator.ofFloat(0f, 1f);
+        private float phase;
+
+        Ps5AmbientBackground() {
+            animator.setDuration(22000L);
+            animator.setRepeatCount(android.animation.ValueAnimator.INFINITE);
+            animator.setInterpolator(new android.view.animation.LinearInterpolator());
+            animator.addUpdateListener(a -> {
+                phase = (Float) a.getAnimatedValue();
+                invalidateSelf();
+            });
+        }
+
+        private float wave(float speed, float offset) {
+            return (float) Math.sin((phase * Math.PI * 2.0 * speed) + offset);
+        }
+
+        @Override public void draw(android.graphics.Canvas canvas) {
+            android.graphics.Rect b = getBounds();
+            float w = b.width(), h = b.height();
+            if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;
+            canvas.drawColor(0xFF05070B);
+
+            // Three independently drifting light fields create depth without washing out the UI.
+            float driftA = wave(1.0f, 0f) * w * 0.13f;
+            float driftB = wave(0.63f, 1.8f) * w * 0.17f;
+            float driftC = wave(1.37f, 3.2f) * w * 0.08f;
+            paint.setStyle(android.graphics.Paint.Style.FILL);
+            paint.setShader(new android.graphics.RadialGradient(w * 0.78f + driftA, h * 0.27f,
+                    Math.max(w, h) * 0.76f, new int[]{0x242B5C91, 0x10204470, 0x0005070B},
+                    null, android.graphics.Shader.TileMode.CLAMP));
+            canvas.drawRect(0, 0, w, h, paint);
+            paint.setShader(new android.graphics.RadialGradient(w * 0.16f + driftB, h * 0.78f,
+                    Math.max(w, h) * 0.62f, new int[]{0x18204D82, 0x08204470, 0x0005070B},
+                    null, android.graphics.Shader.TileMode.CLAMP));
+            canvas.drawRect(0, 0, w, h, paint);
+            paint.setShader(new android.graphics.RadialGradient(w * 0.52f + driftC, h * 0.48f,
+                    Math.max(w, h) * 0.45f, new int[]{0x0D4A79B8, 0x0005070B},
+                    null, android.graphics.Shader.TileMode.CLAMP));
+            canvas.drawRect(0, 0, w, h, paint);
+            paint.setShader(null);
+
+            // Broad, very soft light bands move at different speeds behind the cards.
+            paint.setStyle(android.graphics.Paint.Style.STROKE);
+            paint.setStrokeCap(android.graphics.Paint.Cap.ROUND);
+            for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
+                float speed = 0.42f + i * 0.17f;
+                float sway = wave(speed, i * 1.13f);
+                float y = h * (0.18f + i * 0.16f);
+                paint.setStrokeWidth(Math.max(1f, w * (i % 2 == 0 ? 0.0022f : 0.0012f)));
+                paint.setShader(new android.graphics.LinearGradient(0, y - h * 0.25f, w, y + h * 0.25f,
+                        new int[]{0x00000000, i % 2 == 0 ? 0x173D6FA8 : 0x103E83B9,
+                                i % 2 == 0 ? 0x0D8CB9E8 : 0x164A83C4, 0x00000000},
+                        null, android.graphics.Shader.TileMode.CLAMP));
+                ribbon.reset();
+                ribbon.moveTo(-w * 0.16f, y + h * (0.08f + sway * 0.035f));
+                ribbon.cubicTo(w * 0.20f + sway * w * 0.10f, y - h * 0.22f,
+                        w * 0.68f - sway * w * 0.12f, y + h * 0.25f,
+                        w * 1.16f, y - h * (0.07f + sway * 0.025f));
+                canvas.drawPath(ribbon, paint);
+            }
+            paint.setShader(null);
+
+            // Layer 1: a denser field of distant particles with independent parallax and twinkle.
+            paint.setStyle(android.graphics.Paint.Style.FILL);
+            for (int i = 0; i < 128; i++) {
+                float seed = i * 2.399f;
+                float depth = 0.012f + (i % 5) * 0.009f;
+                float x = (float) ((i * 0.6180339f % 1.0f) * w
+                        + wave(0.22f + (i % 6) * 0.095f, seed) * w * depth);
+                float y = (float) ((i * 0.381966f % 1.0f) * h
+                        + wave(0.19f + (i % 4) * 0.105f, seed * 0.7f) * h * depth);
+                float twinkle = 0.5f + 0.5f * wave(0.7f + (i % 7) * 0.13f, seed * 1.7f);
+                int alpha = 10 + (int) (twinkle * (i % 9 == 0 ? 42 : 19));
+                paint.setColor((alpha << 24) | (i % 5 == 0 ? 0x009FD7FF : 0x006FA9E8));
+                float radius = Math.max(1f, w * (i % 11 == 0 ? 0.0022f : 0.00085f));
+                canvas.drawCircle(x, y, radius, paint);
+            }
+
+            // Layer 2: slow luminous motes with tiny horizontal trails for visible movement.
+            paint.setStrokeCap(android.graphics.Paint.Cap.ROUND);
+            for (int i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
+                float seed = i * 1.731f + 0.8f;
+                float x = (float) ((i * 0.754877f % 1.0f) * w
+                        + wave(0.42f + (i % 4) * 0.16f, seed) * w * 0.055f);
+                float y = (float) ((i * 0.56984f % 1.0f) * h
+                        + wave(0.31f + (i % 3) * 0.17f, seed * 0.8f) * h * 0.04f);
+                float glow = 0.5f + 0.5f * wave(0.55f, seed);
+                int alpha = 18 + (int) (glow * 35);
+                paint.setColor((alpha << 24) | 0x009DD9FF);
+                paint.setStrokeWidth(Math.max(1f, w * 0.0011f));
+                canvas.drawLine(x - w * 0.009f, y, x + w * (0.004f + glow * 0.009f), y - h * 0.002f, paint);
+                canvas.drawCircle(x, y, Math.max(1f, w * 0.0015f), paint);
+            }
+            // Layer 3: occasional four-point star glints that gently brighten and fade.
+            paint.setStyle(android.graphics.Paint.Style.STROKE);
+            paint.setStrokeCap(android.graphics.Paint.Cap.ROUND);
+            for (int i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
+                float seed = i * 2.173f + 1.1f;
+                float x = (float) ((i * 0.683281f % 1.0f) * w
+                        + wave(0.28f + (i % 5) * 0.12f, seed) * w * 0.035f);
+                float y = (float) ((i * 0.414214f % 1.0f) * h
+                        + wave(0.23f + (i % 4) * 0.14f, seed * 0.9f) * h * 0.03f);
+                float sparkle = 0.5f + 0.5f * wave(0.9f + (i % 3) * 0.22f, seed);
+                int alpha = 8 + (int) (sparkle * 54);
+                paint.setColor((alpha << 24) | 0x00C5E7FF);
+                float arm = Math.max(2f, w * (0.002f + sparkle * 0.0022f));
+                paint.setStrokeWidth(Math.max(1f, w * 0.0008f));
+                canvas.drawLine(x - arm, y, x + arm, y, paint);
+                canvas.drawLine(x, y - arm, x, y + arm, paint);
+                canvas.drawCircle(x, y, Math.max(1f, arm * 0.22f), paint);
+            }
+            paint.setStyle(android.graphics.Paint.Style.FILL);
+            paint.setColor(android.graphics.Color.WHITE);
+        }
+
+        @Override protected void onBoundsChange(android.graphics.Rect bounds) { invalidateSelf(); }
+        @Override public void setAlpha(int alpha) { paint.setAlpha(alpha); invalidateSelf(); }
+        @Override public void setColorFilter(android.graphics.ColorFilter filter) { paint.setColorFilter(filter); invalidateSelf(); }
+        @Override public int getOpacity() { return android.graphics.PixelFormat.OPAQUE; }
+        @Override public void start() { if (!animator.isStarted()) animator.start(); }
+        @Override public void stop() { animator.cancel(); }
+        @Override public boolean isRunning() { return animator.isRunning(); }

+    // Two crisp, high-pitched ticks with a fast decay: a light console-style UI response.
+    private static AudioTrack uiTickTrack;
+    private static long lastClickAt;
+    private static synchronized void click(View view) {
+        long now = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
+        if (now - lastClickAt < 55) return;
+        lastClickAt = now;
+        try {
+            if (uiTickTrack == null) {
+                final int rate = 44100;
+                short[] samples = new short[(int) (rate * 0.085f)];
+                for (int i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) {
+                    float t = i / (float) rate;
+                    float local;
+                    float frequency;
+                    if (t < 0.010f) { local = t; frequency = 2850f; }
+                    else if (t >= 0.032f && t < 0.044f) { local = t - 0.032f; frequency = 3450f; }
+                    else continue;
+                    float envelope = (float) Math.exp(-local * 360f);
+                    float wave = (float) Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * frequency * local);
+                    samples[i] = (short) (wave * envelope * 5200f);
+                }
+                uiTickTrack = new AudioTrack(AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC, rate,
+                        AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO, AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT,
+                        samples.length * 2, AudioTrack.MODE_STATIC);
+                uiTickTrack.write(samples, 0, samples.length);
+                uiTickTrack.setVolume(0.55f);
+            }
+            if (uiTickTrack.getPlayState() == AudioTrack.PLAYSTATE_PLAYING) uiTickTrack.stop();
+            uiTickTrack.setPlaybackHeadPosition(0);
+            uiTickTrack.play();
+        } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {
+            // Sound is optional; never interrupt navigation if audio is unavailable.
+        }
+    }

+    private static float safeFocusScaleX(View view, Context c, float requested) {
+        if (view.getWidth() <= 0 || view.getParent() == null) return 1f;
+        View root = view.getRootView();
+        int[] pos = new int[2], rootPos = new int[2];

+                rootPos[0] + root.getWidth() - gutter - center);

+        return Math.max(1f, Math.min(requested, safe));

+    private static final class SettingFocusDrawable extends Drawable implements android.graphics.drawable.Animatable {
+        private final android.graphics.Paint edge = new android.graphics.Paint(android.graphics.Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);

+        SettingFocusDrawable(float radius, float stroke, float gap) {

+            this.stroke = stroke;
+            this.gap = gap;

+        @Override public void draw(android.graphics.Canvas canvas) {
+            android.graphics.Rect b = getBounds();
+            float inset = gap + stroke * 0.5f;
+            bounds.set(b.left + inset, b.top + inset, b.right - inset, b.bottom - inset);
+            if (bounds.width() <= 0 || bounds.height() <= 0) return;

+            pill.addRoundRect(bounds, radius, radius, android.graphics.Path.Direction.CW);

+            sheen.setLocalMatrix(shimmerMatrix);
+            canvas.drawRect(bounds, shimmer);

+                    android.graphics.Color.argb(Math.round(112f * focusAlpha), 255, 255, 255));

+        }

+    private static final class SharedFocusController {
+        final ViewGroup host;
+        final SharedFocusGlow glow;
+        final android.animation.ValueAnimator slide = android.animation.ValueAnimator.ofFloat(0f, 1f);
+        float fromLeft, fromTop, fromRight, fromBottom;
+        float toLeft, toTop, toRight, toBottom;
+        boolean positioned;
+        boolean attached = true;
+
+        SharedFocusController(ViewGroup host, float radius) {
+            this.host = host;
+            glow = new SharedFocusGlow(radius);
+            slide.setDuration(420);
+            slide.setInterpolator(new android.view.animation.PathInterpolator(0.4f, 0f, 0.2f, 1f));
+            slide.addUpdateListener(a -> {
+                float t = (Float) a.getAnimatedValue();
+                float l = fromLeft + (toLeft - fromLeft) * t;
+                float top = fromTop + (toTop - fromTop) * t;
+                float r = fromRight + (toRight - fromRight) * t;
+                float bottom = fromBottom + (toBottom - fromBottom) * t;
+                glow.setBounds(Math.round(l), Math.round(top), Math.round(r), Math.round(bottom));
+            });
+            host.getOverlay().add(glow);
+            glow.startBreathing();
+        }
+
+        void moveTo(View row, float radius) {
+            // clearIfIdle() may have removed the overlay while focus was outside this list.
+            // Reattach it before every new focus so returning to the list never loses the frame.
+            if (!attached) {
+                host.getOverlay().add(glow);
+                attached = true;
+            }
+            glow.startBreathing();
+            int[] rowPos = new int[2], hostPos = new int[2];
+            row.getLocationOnScreen(rowPos);
+            host.getLocationOnScreen(hostPos);
+            float left = rowPos[0] - hostPos[0] - dp(host.getContext(), 4);
+            float top = rowPos[1] - hostPos[1] - dp(host.getContext(), 3);
+            float right = left + row.getWidth() + dp(host.getContext(), 8);
+            float bottom = top + row.getHeight() + dp(host.getContext(), 6);
+            glow.setRadius(dp(host.getContext(), radius));
+            slide.cancel();
+            if (!positioned) {
+                fromLeft = left; fromTop = top; fromRight = right; fromBottom = bottom;
+                positioned = true;
+                glow.setBounds(Math.round(left), Math.round(top), Math.round(right), Math.round(bottom));
+            } else {
+                fromLeft = glow.getBounds().left;
+                fromTop = glow.getBounds().top;
+                fromRight = glow.getBounds().right;
+                fromBottom = glow.getBounds().bottom;
+            }
+            toLeft = left; toTop = top; toRight = right; toBottom = bottom;
+            slide.start();
+        }
+
+        void clearIfIdle() {
+            host.post(() -> {
+                if (host.findFocus() == null) {
+                    slide.cancel();
+                    glow.stopBreathing();
+                    host.getOverlay().remove(glow);
+                    attached = false;
+                    positioned = false;
+                }
+            });
+        }

+        SharedFocusGlow(float radius) {

+        @Override public void draw(android.graphics.Canvas canvas) {

+                rimGradient.setLocalMatrix(gradientMatrix);

+    private static void animateFocusContent(View view, boolean focused) {

+package dev.nxnative.android;
+
+import android.graphics.Bitmap;
+import android.graphics.BitmapFactory;
+import android.os.Handler;
+import android.os.Looper;
+
+import java.io.File;
+import java.util.Locale;
+import java.util.function.Consumer;
+
+/** Reads optional cover and background artwork from a selected Switch dump's RomFS Logo folder. */
+final class GameArtwork {
+    static final class Artwork {
+        final Bitmap icon, background;
+        Artwork(Bitmap icon, Bitmap background) { this.icon = icon; this.background = background; }
+    }
+
+    private static final Handler MAIN = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
+    private GameArtwork() {}
+
+    static void load(File dump, Consumer<Artwork> done) {
+        if (dump == null || !dump.isDirectory()) {
+            MAIN.post(() -> done.accept(new Artwork(null, null)));
+            return;
+        }
+        new Thread(() -> {
+            File logo = findLogo(dump);
+            Bitmap icon = decode(findImage(logo, new String[]{"icon", "icon0", "game_icon", "cover", "title"}), 512);
+            Bitmap background = decode(findImage(logo, new String[]{"background", "bg", "banner"}), 1920);
+            Artwork artwork = new Artwork(icon, background);
+            MAIN.post(() -> done.accept(artwork));
+        }, "nx-game-artwork").start();
+    }
+
+    private static File findLogo(File dump) {
+        File updates = new File(dump, "updates");
+        File fixed = new File(updates, "655360/romfs/Logo");
+        if (fixed.isDirectory()) return fixed;
+        File direct = new File(dump, "romfs/Logo");
+        if (direct.isDirectory()) return direct;
+        File logo = new File(dump, "Logo");
+        if (logo.isDirectory()) return logo;
+        File[] updateDirs = updates.listFiles();
+        if (updateDirs != null) for (File update : updateDirs) {
+            File candidate = new File(update, "romfs/Logo");
+            if (candidate.isDirectory()) return candidate;
+        }
+        return null;
+    }
+
+    private static File findImage(File logo, String[] preferred) {
+        if (logo == null || !logo.isDirectory()) return null;
+        for (String name : preferred) {
+            File exact = new File(logo, name);
+            if (isImage(exact)) return exact;
+            for (String ext : new String[]{".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".webp"}) {
+                File withExt = new File(logo, name + ext);
+                if (isImage(withExt)) return withExt;
+            }
+        }
+        File backgroundDir = new File(logo, "background");
+        File found = firstImage(backgroundDir);
+        if (found != null) return found;
+        return firstImage(logo);
+    }
+
+    private static File firstImage(File dir) {
+        if (dir == null || !dir.isDirectory()) return isImage(dir) ? dir : null;
+        File[] files = dir.listFiles();
+        if (files == null) return null;
+        java.util.Arrays.sort(files, (a, b) -> a.getName().compareToIgnoreCase(b.getName()));
+        for (File f : files) if (isImage(f)) return f;
+        for (File f : files) if (f.isDirectory()) {
+            File nested = firstImage(f);
+            if (nested != null) return nested;
+        }
+        return null;
+    }
+
+    private static boolean isImage(File f) {
+        if (f == null || !f.isFile()) return false;
+        String n = f.getName().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
+        return n.endsWith(".png") || n.endsWith(".jpg") || n.endsWith(".jpeg") || n.endsWith(".webp");
+    }
+
+    private static Bitmap decode(File file, int maxDimension) {
+        if (!isImage(file)) return null;
+        try {
+            BitmapFactory.Options bounds = new BitmapFactory.Options();
+            bounds.inJustDecodeBounds = true;
+            BitmapFactory.decodeFile(file.getAbsolutePath(), bounds);
+            int sample = 1;
+            while (bounds.outWidth / sample > maxDimension || bounds.outHeight / sample > maxDimension) sample *= 2;
+            BitmapFactory.Options options = new BitmapFactory.Options();
+            options.inSampleSize = sample;
+            options.inPreferredConfig = Bitmap.Config.RGB_565;
+            return BitmapFactory.decodeFile(file.getAbsolutePath(), options);
+        } catch (OutOfMemoryError | RuntimeException e) {
+            return null;
+        }
+    }
+}

 1 file changed, 20 insertions(+)

diff --git a/android/app/src/main/java/dev/nxnative/android/GameArtwork.java b/android/app/src/main/java/dev/nxnative/android/GameArtwork.java
index 2b12bb79..86f00417 100644
--- a/android/app/src/main/java/dev/nxnative/android/GameArtwork.java

@@ -46,6 +46,26 @@ private static File findLogo(File dump) {
             File candidate = new File(update, "romfs/Logo");
             if (candidate.isDirectory()) return candidate;
         }
+        // Some dumps add extra wrapper folders. Search the selected folder's
+        // subdirectories for a Logo directory after checking the known layouts.
+        return findNamedDirectory(dump, "Logo", 0, 8);
+    }
+
+    private static File findNamedDirectory(File dir, String name, int depth, int maxDepth) {
+        if (dir == null || !dir.isDirectory() || depth > maxDepth) return null;
+        File[] children = dir.listFiles();
+        if (children == null) return null;
+        java.util.Arrays.sort(children, (a, b) -> a.getName().compareToIgnoreCase(b.getName()));
+        for (File child : children) {
+            if (child.isDirectory() && child.getName().equalsIgnoreCase(name)) return child;
+        }
+        for (File child : children) {
+            if (!child.isDirectory()) continue;
+            String n = child.getName().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
+            if (n.equals("android") || n.equals("data") || n.equals("cache") || n.equals(".git")) continue;
+            File found = findNamedDirectory(child, name, depth + 1, maxDepth);
+            if (found != null) return found;
+        }
         return null;
     }

+    private void saveHomeArtwork(Uri uri, boolean background) {
+        Game target = pendingArtworkGame;
+        pendingArtworkGame = null;
+        if (target == null) return;
+        new Thread(() -> {
+            File saved = null;
+            String error = null;
+            try (InputStream in = getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri)) {
+                if (in == null) throw new IOException("The selected image could not be opened.");
+                File dir = new File(getFilesDir(), "home-artwork");
+                if (!dir.exists() && !dir.mkdirs()) throw new IOException("Could not create the artwork folder.");
+                String mime = getContentResolver().getType(uri);
+                String ext = mime != null && mime.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("png") ? ".png"
+                        : mime != null && mime.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("webp") ? ".webp" : ".jpg";
+                saved = new File(dir, target.titleId + (background ? "-background" : "-icon") + ext);
+                try (FileOutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(saved)) {
+                    byte[] buffer = new byte[16384]; int n; long total = 0;
+                    while ((n = in.read(buffer)) != -1) {
+                        total += n;
+                        if (total > 32L * 1024L * 1024L) throw new IOException("Choose an image smaller than 32 MB.");
+                        out.write(buffer, 0, n);
+                    }
+                }
+                android.graphics.BitmapFactory.Options bounds = new android.graphics.BitmapFactory.Options();
+                bounds.inJustDecodeBounds = true;
+                android.graphics.BitmapFactory.decodeFile(saved.getAbsolutePath(), bounds);
+                if (bounds.outWidth <= 0 || bounds.outHeight <= 0) throw new IOException("That file is not a supported image.");
+                GameArtwork.setOverride(this, target.titleId, background, saved.getAbsolutePath());
+            } catch (Exception e) { error = e.getMessage(); if (saved != null) saved.delete(); }
+            String problem = error;
+            runOnUiThread(() -> {
+                if (isFinishing()) return;
+                if (problem != null) { error("Artwork not changed: " + problem); return; }
+                Toast.makeText(this, background ? "Home background updated" : "Game icon updated", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
+                refresh();
+            });
+        }, "nx-home-artwork").start();

 .../dev/nxnative/android/GameSurfaceView.java | 68 +++++++++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 68 insertions(+)

diff --git a/android/app/src/main/java/dev/nxnative/android/GameSurfaceView.java b/android/app/src/main/java/dev/nxnative/android/GameSurfaceView.java
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..8cf64c36
--- /dev/null
+++ b/android/app/src/main/java/dev/nxnative/android/GameSurfaceView.java
@@ -0,0 +1,68 @@
+package dev.nxnative.android;
+
+import android.content.Context;
+import android.util.AttributeSet;
+import android.view.MotionEvent;
+import android.view.SurfaceView;
+
+/**
+ * The game's input surface. Normal gameplay touches go straight from this view to the
+ * native touch layer; TouchControls remains a visual overlay and only intercepts its
+ * own toggle/editor gestures.
+ */
+final class GameSurfaceView extends SurfaceView {
+    private Runnable inputChanged;
+
+    GameSurfaceView(Context context) {
+        super(context);
+        setFocusable(true);
+        setFocusableInTouchMode(true);
+    }
+
+    GameSurfaceView(Context context, AttributeSet attrs) {
+        super(context, attrs);
+        setFocusable(true);
+        setFocusableInTouchMode(true);
+    }
+
+    void setInputChangedListener(Runnable listener) {
+        inputChanged = listener;
+    }
+
+    @Override public boolean onTouchEvent(MotionEvent event) {
+        if (!Native.hasInput()) return true;
+        int action = event.getActionMasked();
+        switch (action) {
+            case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
+            case MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_DOWN: {
+                int i = event.getActionIndex();
+                Native.touch(action, event.getPointerId(i),
+                        event.getX(i) / Math.max(1, getWidth()),
+                        event.getY(i) / Math.max(1, getHeight()));
+                break;
+            }
+            case MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE:
+                for (int i = 0; i < event.getPointerCount(); i++) {
+                    Native.touch(action, event.getPointerId(i),
+                            event.getX(i) / Math.max(1, getWidth()),
+                            event.getY(i) / Math.max(1, getHeight()));
+                }
+                break;
+            case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
+            case MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_UP: {
+                int i = event.getActionIndex();
+                Native.touch(action, event.getPointerId(i),
+                        event.getX(i) / Math.max(1, getWidth()),
+                        event.getY(i) / Math.max(1, getHeight()));
+                break;
+            }
+            case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
+                Native.touch(action, 0, 0, 0);
+                break;
+            default:
+                return true;
+        }
+        if (inputChanged != null) inputChanged.run();
+        return true;
+    }
+}
